definitions.ild: mean pairwise cosine distance between the picks' vectors (higher = more varied)
definitions.format_spread: entropy of the picks' formats over log(list length); 1 = every pick a different format
definitions.novelty: 1 - popularity percentile within the source (votes, views or citations); 1 = rarely seen
definitions.unexpectedness: 1 - percentile of closeness to the person's own words (keyword overlap, session similarity)
definitions.serendipity: mean of good * unexpectedness over the picks
definitions.creativity: mean of good * sqrt(novelty * unexpectedness) over the picks
definitions.interest_coverage: share of the session's own interests that at least one shown pick answers
definitions.unique_share: distinct items / slots shown across all lists (1 = no item is ever repeated); point value, no interval
definitions.gini: inequality of how often each shown item appears (0 = all equally often)
definitions.top_item_share: the most repeated item's share of all slots
